decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system is a core part of the firm's coolant management offering and has stayed on the website, so management has no clear sign of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

The cleaning centrifuge complements the coolant line, and a large established firm has the organisational slack to carry it while its results are still uncertain, especially after the portfolio was already trimmed by dropping the nozzles.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard product in machine tool peripherals and remained listed after the magnetic belt variant was cut, which suggests it meets aspirations.
Hinged belt conveyors are among the most widely demanded chip conveyor types and stayed on the market through the 2024 portfolio pruning, so the firm is likely to keep it.
